LESSON: READING 4.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION – POETRY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information – Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information – Poetry, part of Strand 4 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why should there be security measures in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. surf the internet or check the library for poems on safety at school,

2. conduct a reader’s theatre to read the poems,

3. discuss some of the safety precautions that should be taken to ensure safety in school,

4. answer direct and inferential questions from the poems read,

5. create a collection of new vocabulary related to safety in school from the poems read,

6. infer meaning of the vocabulary from the context of the poems,

7. construct sentences using the vocabulary identified,

8. recite the poems read during club activities.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. surf the internet or check the library for poems on safety at school,
2. conduct a reader’s theatre to read the poems,
3. discuss some of the safety precautions that should be taken to ensure safety in school,
4. answer direct and inferential questions from the poems read,
5. create a collection of new vocabulary related to safety in school from the poems read,
6. infer meaning of the vocabulary from the context of the poems,
7. construct sentences using the vocabulary identified,
8. recite the poems read during club activities.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information – Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is developed as the learner uses digital technology to surf the internet or check the library for poems on

safety at school.

• Self-efficacy is realised as the learner shows defining personal skills when reciting the poems read during club activities.

Values:
• Respect: This is developed as the learner displays patience when conducting a reader’s theatre to read the poems.

• Love: The learner exhibits care and compassion by discussing some of the safety precautions that should be taken to ensure

safety in school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social Cohesion: It is developed as the learner discusses with peers the safety precautions that should be taken for security in

school.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of poetry to their learning in English and Kiswahili.
